transcript.speaker: Analyst, Peace Wealth|Tushar Khurana
transcript.text: If you just can comment on how much dues we have recovered from the BSNL in particular and how much are still due that we have to receive from BSNL? And by when do we expect that payment to come in?

transcript.speaker: CEO
transcript.text: So I think from BSNL now we have come to the timelines for the milestone deliveries. We have met the milestone delivery requirements. transcript.speaker: Analyst, Peace Wealth|Tushar Khurana
transcript.text: And sir, the order book that we have mentioned this time, INR2,300 crores, does it also include this BSNL order for INR1,500 crores we got from TCS.

transcript.text: A part of it because we have received the LOI for the entire amount. transcript.speaker: Analyst, Peace Wealth|Tushar Khurana

notes.text: 1EBIT = PBT – Other Income + Finance Cost including Net forex loss
1Net working capital taken as Current Assets (excluding Cash & Cash Equivalents) net of Current Liabilities (excluding Borrowings and lease liabilities)
2Cash and cash equivalents includes investment in liquid mutual funds, deposits, other Bank balances
Net Working Capital is lower at 4,235 Cr vs 4,478 Cr in Q1FY27 due to decreased Trade Receivables on account of collections, non-recourse discounting and Customer advance settlements.
Net Debt increased to 4,384 Cr vs 4,277 Cr in Q1FY27 on account of increased operational and capex funding.

provenance.caveats: Loss-making with negative EBITDA, worsened QoQ ((99) Cr in Q1). Net debt rose to INR 4,384 Cr (from 4,277 Cr), stated in the transcript only. Order book INR 2,315 Cr. Presentation is short (13 slides, ~9.5k chars). Transcript is the Q2 FY27 call of 16 Oct 2026.
